## Feature Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to TNGBackup.

## Use Case
Explain the use case(s) this feature would enable. Why is this important?

Example:
- I'm trying to... but TNGBackup doesn't support...
- This would help with... by allowing...

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. What would the command/option look like?

Example:
```bash
# Ideal usage after feature is implemented
tngbackup extract --archive=backup-2026-09-05 --path=/important/file /restore/here
```

## Alternative Approaches
Have you considered other ways to achieve the same goal? What are the trade-offs?

## Additional Context
- Related operations or features in TNGBackup
- Links to Borg Backup documentation if relevant
- Any dependency on other tools or changes
